notes.title: Recruits - Development Status
notes.notes:
Hello everybody from Steam community,

First of all, we ask the most sincere apologies about the lack of information and updates on the development of Recruits.

We would also like to announce that [url=www.qubyteinteractive.com][b]QUByte Interactive[/b][/url] established a commitment to [b]Commotion Games[/b] and will continue developing Recruits.

At this moment, we are doing a careful review in the game, collecting feedback and working together with the game creators.

However, before we restart the development process, we are making a very important task: migrate the entire game UDK3 technology for Unreal 4 with the intention of keeping the game with the quality it deserves. In the near future, it migration will give you the opportunity to play on other platforms.

Our main focus today is the version of Steam for Windows. After that, we will go to other platforms.

To reward the patience of all players, we are offering you a small gift: a free Recruits OST (will be available here on Steam).

In addition, for all those who have already bought the Recruits, we are sending you a key of our game  [url=store.steampowered.com/app/288650/]HTR+ Slot Car Simulation.[/url]

Unfortunately, we can not reward you with Steam version. So, we will send you to another online [url=www.nuuvem.com/item/htr-plus-slot-car-simulation]store[/url]. Please, send us an e-mail to contact@qubyteinteractive.com and you will receive the key.

From now on, we will be here answering everybody and collecting feedbacks.

We believe in the potential and we enjoy Recruits. We want to continue the great work done by Commotion Games and deliver you an amazing game. You deserve it!

Thank you.
QUByte Team

notes.title: Alpha 0.5.3 Now Live
notes.notes:
[img=http://recruitsgame.com/images/steamupdates/R_SteamUpdate_053.png]
[b][h1]Alpha 0.5.3 - Aug 6, 2014[/h1][/b]

We have been busy getting things working better and fixed up as per your feedback and suggestions and now we have another little update. We want to also thank you all for the feedback and great multiplayer game we have been playing with you guys. 

Note: This update may reset Controls and video options. Hopefully this will be the last update to do this.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Squad Command Menu has different options depending if aiming at Enemy or Squad Member
[*]Added super basic Melee
[*]Added Random Delay to when enemies throw grenades so not instant.
[*]Show warning when trying to deploy in MP without recruit selected
[*]show warning when trying to create server without name
[*]Use Progress Bar shows above head when using objectives (planting C4 etc..)
[*]MP Commander XP and Respect points earned and updated per kill instead of per game.
[*]Refactored Use tooltip Code to make MUCH more consistent and accurate
[*]Use key utilizes Priority layering For when multiple usable objects overlapping
[/list]

Bugs:
[list]
[*]Fix next round time on official servers
[*]Fixed Flash grenade selection throwing Molotov
[*]Roofs in Village now have proper Collision.
[*]Swapping Squad mates does not change weapons
[*]Removed BSP from Village Level
[*]Chat Text Field No longer overlaps with chat log
[*]Enemies Should no longer throw grenades after death.
[*]Fixed connecting to Official Server Listings if Steam Server is in list
[*]Pickup Weapon tooltip Hides when weapon despawns
[*]Fixed grenades not getting thrown correctly in multiplayer
[/list]

Remember to head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/246880/discussions/][b]Discussion Forums[/b][/url] and post any bug or ideas you have for Recruits.

notes.title: Alpha 0.5.3
notes.notes:
We have been busy in the trenches these last few days trying to get some of the bugs/confusing systems ironed out. As always we are grateful for everyone that has been leaving feedback during our launch!

We will probably do another bugfix update in the next few days, and then switch to slightly less frequent updates as we start to churn out new content and features (and better AI!).

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] This update will reset your Video and Control settings. This should be the last update to cause this, and may only happen again if significant Control/Video changes are done in an update.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Squad Command Menu has different options depending if aiming at Enemy or Squad Member
[*]Added super basic Melee
[*]Added Random Delay to when enemies throw grenades so not instant.
[*]Show warning when trying to deploy in MP without recruit selected
[*]Show warning when trying to create server without name
[*]Progress Bar shows above head when using objectives (planting C4 etc..)
[*]MP Commander XP and Respect points earned and updated per kill instead of per game.
[*]Refactored Use tooltip Code to make MUCH more consistent and accurate
[*]Use key utilizes Priority layering For when multiple usable objects overlapping
[*]Run animation slows down and speeds up based on speed
[/list]

[h1]Bugs:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix next round countdown on servers
[*]Fixed Flash grenade selection throwing Molotov
[*]Roofs in Village now have proper Collision.
[*]Swapping Squad mates does not change weapons
[*]Removed BSP from Village Level
[*]Chat Text Field No longer overlaps with chat log
[*]Enemies Should no longer throw grenades after death.
[*]Fixed connecting to Official Server Listings if Steam Server is in list
[*]Pickup Weapon tooltip Hides when weapon despawns
[/list]

Remember to head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/246880/discussions/][b]Discussion Forums[/b][/url] and post any Bugs or Ideas you have for Recruits.

notes.title: Alpha 0.5.2 Now Live
notes.notes:
[img=http://recruitsgame.com/images/steamupdates/R_SteamUpdate_052.png]
[b][h1]Alpha 0.5.2 - Aug 2, 2014[/h1][/b]
We just want to thank everyone for all the feedback during our launch. We have had tons of bugs and note and comments and believe me when I say we are very grateful for them all!

Now, we have done some fixes and changes and pushed them out for everyone to test. Take a look below for the latest change log for Recruits. We are still doing fixes and changes and starting to get back into content development.

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Show warning screen when launching without recruits
[*]Squad members move to point even if cant resolve on nav mesh as long as clear line of sight
[*]Add Scroll Bar to resolution Select in Options Menu and Map select.
[*]Removed Kill all enemies objective from Tank Level
[*]Objectives HUD stays open by default
[*]Single Player Memorial list now sorts by latest death at top
[/list]
[h1]Bugs:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Helicopter Mission Final Objective now assigned properly
[*]Fixed issue in tank mission with destroying barricade before being assigned objective
[*]Fixed Squad Hud from bugging out when swapping recruits with 1234 keys.
[*]Tips now trigger more consistently
[*]Can no longer shoot through walls if gun is clipped through them
[*]Squad HUD no longer overlaps entries on certain resolutions (1920x1080)
[*]Fixed Memorial Death Dates being clipped in menu
[/list]

Remember to head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/246880/discussions/][b]Discussion Forums[/b][/url] and post any Bugs or Ideas you have for Recruits.
